pattern: group by entity, conditional sum and count, single-row share calculation
question: share of money raised from repeat givers versus one-time givers, in percent, plus a count of repeat givers
gold_sql: WITH counts AS (SELECT "Donor", COUNT(*) AS gifts, SUM("Amount") AS donor_total FROM donations GROUP BY "Donor") SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN gifts > 1 THEN donor_total ELSE 0 END) / SUM(donor_total) AS repeat_share_percent, SUM(CASE WHEN gifts > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS repeat_donor_count FROM counts
sql_duckdb: WITH donor_counts AS (SELECT "Donor", COUNT(*) AS total_donations FROM "donations" GROUP BY "Donor"), donor_classification AS (SELECT "Donor", total_donations, CASE WHEN total_donations > 1 THEN 'repeat' ELSE 'one-time' END AS giver_type FROM donor_counts), giver_stats AS (SELECT giver_type, COUNT(*) AS giver_count, SUM(d."Amount") AS total_amount FROM "donations" AS d JOIN donor_classification AS dc ON d."Donor" = dc."Donor" GROUP BY giver_type) SELECT (repeat.total_amount * 100.0 / NULLIF(NULLIF(one_time.total_amount + repeat.total_amount, 0), 0)) AS repeat_share_percent, one_time.total_amount + repeat.total_amount AS total_amount, repeat.giver_count AS repeat_giver_count FROM giver_stats AS repeat CROSS JOIN giver_stats AS one_time

CURRENT QUESTION:
share of money raised from repeat givers versus one-time givers, in percent, plus a count of repeat givers
attempts.response:
WITH donor_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    "Donor",
    COUNT(*) AS total_donations
  FROM "donations"
  GROUP BY "Donor"
),
donor_classification AS (
  SELECT 
    "Donor",
    total_donations,
    CASE 
      WHEN total_donations > 1 THEN 'repeat'
      ELSE 'one-time'
    END AS giver_type
  FROM donor_counts
),
giver_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    giver_type,
    COUNT(*) AS giver_count,
    SUM(d."Amount") AS total_amount
  FROM "donations" d
  JOIN donor_classification dc ON d."Donor" = dc."Donor"
  GROUP BY giver_type
)
SELECT 
  (repeat.total_amount * 100.0 / NULLIF(one_time.total_amount + repeat.total_amount, 0)) AS repeat_share_percent,
  one_time.total_amount + repeat.total_amount AS total_amount,
  repeat.giver_count AS repeat_giver_count
FROM giver_stats repeat
CROSS JOIN giver_stats one_time;
